title: Every enforced record bites: a planted violation turns the check red in each init stack
body:
Why: Fable direction 1115e slice 4 (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-direction-1115e.md): prove every enforced record bites in a fresh project.
Outcome: in each of the five init stacks, each applicable enforced record's violation is planted; the check goes red naming the record and remedy, green after revert; an enforced record without a plant fails the test; report prints 'N/N records bite'.
Files: scripts/standards-audit.ts, new test under test/.
Proof: the new test passes with N/N; removing one plant turns it red. Free.
